key.name: mode
key.description: Easing curve applied to long animations. "ease-in-out-*" curves accelerate at the start and decelerate at the end (two-sided). "ease-out-*" only decelerate. "back"/"elastic" overshoot/bounce.

key.name: threshold-ms
key.description: Only animations at or above this duration get the easing curve. Lower = more things eased (hovers ~100ms); higher = fewer.

key.name: duration-scale
key.description: Multiplier for the duration of eased animations. 1.0 = GNOME's default (quick); 1.8 ≈ macOS; 2.5 = slow/luxurious.

key.name: gesture-duration-scale
key.description: Duration multiplier for animations during/after a touchpad gesture (workspace switch, app-grid paging). The easing curve is kept at GNOME's velocity-matched EASE_OUT_CUBIC so there's no jolt on release; this only stretches the duration so the deceleration reads more. 1.0 = gestures fully native.

key.name: gesture-grace-ms
key.description: Window after a touchpad gesture (3-finger swipe/pinch) during which animations play at GNOME's native speed. Touchpad-driven overview/workspace opens already track your finger, so their wrap-up shouldn't be slowed. Set 0 to disable the exception (ease everything, including gestures).

key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch (A/B without disabling the whole extension).

key.name: magic-lamp-easing
key.description: If compiz-alike-magic-lamp-effect is installed, curve its minimize/unminimize timeline with EASE_OUT_CUBIC so the window decelerates into the dock instead of stopping dead. No-op if magic-lamp isn't installed.
